steps.text: The module opens on the "Tariffs" tab. This is where you set the price of the shared energy before generating invoices. The "Generate" and "Tracking" tabs come next.
steps.title: The billing module

steps.text: Select the sharing operation to bill. Tariffs and invoices are always scoped to an operation.
steps.title: Pick the sharing operation

steps.text: Click "New tariff" to open the creation dialog. By default the tariff covers consumer selling and applies to the whole operation.
steps.title: Add a tariff

steps.text: Pick in the calendar the date from which this tariff applies.
steps.title: Start of validity

steps.text: Enter the price per kWh for this tariff.
steps.title: Price per kWh

steps.text: Enter the shared-kWh price (0.1200 EUR), the start of validity and a label. The "Consumer selling" kind and "Global" scope are right for billing the whole operation.
steps.title: Fill in the tariff

steps.text: Click "Create tariff". It appears immediately in the list and will be used to compute the invoices.
steps.title: Create the tariff

steps.text: The wind operation has producers: their shared injection must be priced too. Open "New tariff" again to create a buyback tariff.
steps.title: Add a buyback tariff

steps.text: Select the "Producer buyback" kind. This tariff pays for the energy producers inject and share with the community.
steps.title: Choose the "Producer buyback" kind

steps.text: Pick the date from which the buyback tariff applies.
steps.title: Start of validity

steps.text: Enter the buyback price per kWh.
steps.title: Buyback price

steps.text: Give the buyback tariff a name that sets it apart in the list.
steps.title: Name the tariff

steps.text: Submit to add the buyback tariff.
steps.title: Create the tariff

steps.text: The operation now has a consumer-selling tariff and a producer-buyback tariff. Let's move on to generating the invoices.
steps.title: The tariffs are saved

steps.text: Open the "Generate" tab. This is where you import the consumption data and launch the invoice computation over a period.
steps.title: Go to generation

steps.text: Select the operation to bill: the consumption-import area appears.
steps.title: Pick the operation to bill

steps.text: Drop the operation's RESA file (the month's 15-minute readings) into the import zone. It provides the shared energy that will be billed.
steps.title: Import the RESA metering file

steps.text: Upload the readings file to compute the coverage of the period.
steps.title: Upload the file

steps.text: Choose the period to bill — here February 2025, the month covered by the imported file. Billing will cover that period's shared energy.
steps.title: Set the period

steps.text: Click "Generate". The computation runs in the background: as soon as it finishes, one invoice per operation member appears.
steps.title: Generate the invoices

steps.text: Each operation member now has a "Draft" invoice. It remains to issue it and then record its payment.
steps.title: The invoices are generated

steps.text: Click an invoice's "Issue" icon. It gets a legal number and a structured communication, and its status becomes "Issued".
steps.title: Issue the invoice

steps.text: Once the invoice is issued, the "Register a payment" (wallet) icon appears. Click it to open the payment dialog.
steps.title: Register a payment

steps.text: The amount is prefilled with the invoice total and the default method is "Bank transfer". Click "Register payment": the invoice moves to "Paid".
steps.title: Confirm the payment

steps.text: The payment is recorded and the invoice now carries the "Paid" status. The full cycle — tariff, generation, issue, payment — is complete.
steps.title: The invoice is paid

title: Bill a sharing operation, from tariff to payment
